info.title: SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search API
info.description: Search SEC EDGAR filings by company name, form type, and date range. Use this tool to look up a company's CIK (Central Index Key) number when you only know the company name or ticker symbol. The CIK can then be used with the SEC EDGAR Data API to retrieve filings and financial data. No authentication required — include a descriptive User-Agent header per SEC policy.

get.summary: Search EDGAR filings by company name or keywords
get.description: Search SEC EDGAR filings by company name, ticker, form type, and date range. Returns matching filings along with an entity_filter aggregation that lists matching companies with their CIK numbers and ticker symbols. Use this to look up a company's CIK number from its name or ticker — the CIK is needed by the SEC EDGAR Data API endpoints (getCompanySubmissions, getCompanyFacts, etc.). To look up a company CIK, search with the company name in quotes and set size to 0 to get only the entity aggregation without individual filing results.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query. Use double quotes for exact phrase matching (e.g., '"apple inc"'). To search by company name for CIK lookup, put the company name in quotes.

parameters.name: forms
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of SEC form types to filter by (e.g., '10-K', '10-Q', '10-K,10-Q,8-K'). Common forms: 10-K (annual report), 10-Q (quarterly report), 8-K (current report), DEF 14A (proxy statement).

parameters.name: dateRange
parameters.description: Date range filter. Use 'custom' with startdt and enddt parameters for a specific range.

parameters.name: startdt
parameters.description: Start date for custom date range filter (YYYY-MM-DD format). Requires dateRange=custom.

parameters.name: enddt
parameters.description: End date for custom date range filter (YYYY-MM-DD format). Requires dateRange=custom.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Starting index for pagination of filing results. Use 0 for the first page.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Number of filing results to return. Set to 0 to get only the entity aggregation (useful for CIK lookups). Maximum 100.

200.description: Search results with filing hits and entity aggregation

hits.description: Array of matching filing documents. Empty when size=0.

ciks.description: CIK numbers of the filing entity (10-digit, zero-padded)

display_names.description: Company display names with ticker symbol and CIK, e.g., 'Apple Inc. (AAPL) (CIK 0000320193)'

sics.description: Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) codes for the company's industry

biz_locations.description: Business location (city, state) of the filing entity

period_ending.description: Period end date for the filing

file_type.description: Specific file type within the filing (e.g., 10-K, EX-21.1)

aggregations.description: Aggregated data from search results — most useful for CIK lookups

entity_filter.description: Aggregation of unique entities (companies) matching the search. Each bucket contains the company name, ticker, and CIK number.

buckets.description: List of matching companies, sorted by number of matching filings. Each key contains the company name, ticker symbol, and CIK in the format: 'Company Name (TICKER) (CIK 0000000000)'

key.description: Company display name with ticker and CIK, e.g., 'Apple Inc. (AAPL) (CIK 0000320193)'. Parse the CIK number from this string to use with other EDGAR API endpoints.

doc_count.description: Number of filings matching the search for this entity
